description: This file contains various data transfer objects (DTOs), request models, and data models representing database tables related to asset management, such as asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations and scalars, data input values, and their respective creation and update request classes. It also includes validation logic for input parameters, ensuring required fields are present based on context.

classes.name: AssetStatusLogDto
classes.description: Map to the 'asset_status_log' table, representing asset status log entries with fields for status periods and metadata.

classes.name: CreateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new asset status log entry with validation annotations.

classes.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing asset status log entry with validation annotations.

classes.name: AdditionalAssetIdDto
classes.description: Map to the 'additional_asset_id' table, managing supplementary asset identifiers.

classes.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new additional asset ID, with validation.

classes.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing additional asset ID.

classes.name: AssetPropertyDto
classes.description: Represents an asset property record in 'asset_property' table.

classes.name: CreateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new asset property, requiring validation annotations.

classes.name: UpdateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an asset property.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents control device mappings linked to assets.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a control device mapping.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a control device mapping.

classes.name: InputParameterDto
classes.description: Represents input parameters for assets, including validation logic based on 'InUseFlag'.

classes.name: CreateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating an input parameter row, with validation for dependent fields.

classes.name: UpdateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating an input parameter, including validation similar to creation.

classes.name: ParentInputMappingDto
classes.description: Represents parent-child input parameter relationships.

classes.name: CreateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model to create a parent input mapping.

classes.name: UpdateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model to update an existing parent input mapping.

classes.name: ReportingAttributeMappingDto
classes.description: Mapping for reporting attributes related to assets.

classes.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Request model to update reporting attribute mappings.

classes.name: EfSourceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents mapping of EF sources for parameters.

classes.name: CreateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Create request model with validation for EF source mapping.

classes.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Update request model with validation for EF source mapping.

classes.name: ThroughputEquationDto
classes.description: Represents throughput equation records.

classes.name: CreateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating throughput equations.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating throughput equations.

classes.name: ThroughputScalarDto
classes.description: Represents throughput scalar data.

classes.name: CreateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating throughput scalars.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating throughput scalars.

classes.name: DataInputValueDto
classes.description: Represents data input values linked to input parameters.

classes.name: CreateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating data input value records.

classes.name: UpdateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating data input value records.
